signposts.label: Village
signposts.lockedText: This path looks overgrown... maybe next time.

signposts.label: Mountain
signposts.lockedText: A tall peak in the distance. Not yet!

signposts.label: River
signposts.lockedText: The river path is quiet for now.

signposts.label: Castle
signposts.lockedText: A castle spire peeks over the trees...

signposts.label: Ancient Ruins
signposts.lockedText: Old stones, half-buried. A story for another day.
